title: Vulnerability, Resilience and Christchurch
welcome_lead: Examine why the same shaking causes catastrophe in one city and inconvenience in another.
meta_desc: A-Level Geography Hazardous Earth: PAR model, vulnerability, Christchurch 2011 earthquake.
final_note: You have grasped why hazard is a social outcome, not just a natural event.

walkthroughs.body_html: Wisner et al.'s PAR (Pressure and Release) Model argues disasters arise where a natural hazard intersects with social vulnerability. Vulnerability has three layers: root causes (political-economic structures), dynamic pressures (urbanisation, deforestation), and unsafe conditions (informal housing, no warning systems). Risk = Hazard x Vulnerability / Capacity. Reducing disaster therefore requires releasing pressure on vulnerable groups, not only engineering against the hazard.

On 22 February 2011, a Mw 6.3 quake struck Christchurch, New Zealand, 5 km SE of the city at 5 km depth. Although moderate in magnitude, peak ground acceleration reached 2.2g vertical, exceptional values. Result: 185 deaths (115 in the CTV Building collapse), ~6,800 injuries, NZ$40bn damage (~20% of GDP). Widespread liquefaction destroyed eastern suburbs (Bexley, Avonside). A red zone of 8,000 properties was permanently abandoned.

Despite severity, the death toll was low relative to comparable quakes (Haiti 2010 Mw 7.0: ~220,000 deaths). New Zealand's resilience reflected: stringent building codes (1976, updated 2004); functioning emergency services; the EQC public insurance scheme; high GDP per capita (~$45,000); rapid reconstruction governance (CERA, 2011-16). The contrast with Haiti illustrates how the same magnitude hazard produces vastly different outcomes depending on development and governance.

mcqs.q: What is the difference between a natural hazard and a natural disaster?
options: It is the hole in the ozone layer letting in more sun.
They are the same thing — any earthquake or hurricane is a disaster.
A hazard happens on land and a disaster happens at sea.
A natural hazard is a physical event with potential to cause harm; it becomes a disaster only when it affects vulnerable people and causes significant impact.

mcqs.q: What is the enhanced greenhouse effect?
options: It is the hole in the ozone layer letting in more sun.
Anticyclones bring heavy rainfall because they trap moisture.
The greenhouse effect is entirely man-made and harmful.
The strengthening of the natural greenhouse effect by human activities (mainly burning fossil fuels) which add CO2 and other gases to the atmosphere.

mcqs.q: What weather does an anticyclone (high pressure system) bring?
options: Descending air warms and dries, suppressing cloud formation — so anticyclones bring clear, settled weather: hot in summer, cold and frosty in winter.
Anticyclones bring heavy rainfall because they trap moisture.
It is the hole in the ozone layer letting in more sun.
High pressure brings stormy weather because the air pushes down hard.
